title: Mirror Marsh — Reliquaries of the Still Tide
status: DRAFT design-only proposal; not imported or runtime-validated

coordinate_contract.order: later rectangles overwrite prior cells; no clearing or alpha-layers
coordinate_contract.host_clearing: none: empty/negative space assumes clear or importer-owned host

style_guide.geometry: staggered drowned arches, narrow mosaic walks, clustered mirror shards, and eightfold low-contrast mineral reeds
style_guide.rhythm: alternating tall punctuation and low continuous sills; 18–28-cell gaps expose the marsh
style_guide.color: roughly 60% dark slate, basalt, aged masonry; 25% wet pale stone and glass; 10% oxidised teal; 5% crystal/brass highlights
style_guide.optics: glass is source-coloured visual metaphor, NOT a verified physical reflection or Godot shader effect
style_guide.avoid: do not represent water and brine as interchangeable; no implicit planting, growth, curing, thermal activation, wind, wave or tide mechanics

features.title: Drowned Moon Gate / salt-eaten aperture
features.role: A half-submerged ceremonial arch with a dark central passage and a broken quartz moon crest.
features.orientation: 0° and 1× only; no reflection or rotation qualification
neighbour_rules: Maintain ≥18 cells of open approach on both sides
Never presume the arch clears a playable actor
Locate on an explicitly empty or importer-owned terrain mask
features.simulation_notes: All original materials are fixed kernel-zero. Visual aperture is not a collision-cleared doorway; negative space does not remove host material.

features.title: Shoal Spine / drowned pilgrim steps
features.role: Low fractured stepping stones, with mineral inlays that resemble pools of sky.
features.orientation: 0° and 1× only; no reflection or rotation qualification
neighbour_rules: Repeat with 14–26-cell gaps, never fuse with active water by default
Keep player path geometry unqualified until Rapier pass
Align baseline; no y-axis flipping
features.simulation_notes: Fixed kernel-zero material only. No actual dynamic water or buoyancy; reflective colours are source material colours, not reflections.

features.title: Fen Prism Cairn / broken sky lens
features.role: Three tapered dark-glass and pale-crystal spires emerge from a salt-grey plinth.
features.orientation: 0° and 1× only; no reflection or rotation qualification
neighbour_rules: Keep 16-cell visual halo around high prism tip
Exclude from asserted walkable floor and collision-safe decoration
Use green glass as a visual mineral accent, not a radiation system
features.simulation_notes: Fixed kernel-zero sources; translucent material swatches do not promise shader refraction, luminescence or structural attachment.

features.title: Sunken Stilt Sanctuary / mirror-scribe altar
features.role: An asymmetrical shrine held above a dark reed-choked floor on heavy basalt pilings.
features.orientation: 0° and 1× only; no reflection or rotation qualification
neighbour_rules: Needs broad empty host rectangle beneath stilts; do not assume they support rigid bodies
Do not place high roof directly below other ceiling modules
Keep 20-cell dry approach on near side
features.simulation_notes: All original source materials fixed/kernel-zero. Tall unsupported-looking lintels remain design-only; no native actor clearance or damage test.

features.title: Verdigris Reed Screen / false botanical screen
features.role: Sculptural copper-stem reeds rise from a narrow stone berm, with glass seed heads.
features.orientation: 0° and 1× only; no reflection or rotation qualification
neighbour_rules: Tile as intermittent foreground rhythm, not a fully opaque wall
Stems are nonmoving fixed material, not simulated vegetation
Keep 15-cell spacing from actual Plant/Spark experimental content
features.simulation_notes: These are architectural imitations of reeds using fixed copper/bronze, not live Plant or combustion/growth kernels.

features.title: Broken Reflection Windows / drowned observatory wall
features.role: A lower terrace of three interrupted window frames; staggered glass facets read as missing reflections.
features.orientation: 0° and 1× only; no reflection or rotation qualification
neighbour_rules: Window passage must not be assumed traversable
Place above a checked substrate where later clearing is defined
Repeat two panels then one gap for ruin rhythm
features.simulation_notes: Inert fixed kernel-zero. Broken window shapes do not fracture dynamically; aperture is visual, not a transparent layer or host eraser.

features.title: Twin Tide Lenses / isolated brine-water experiment
features.role: Paired small pools use different liquid families: Water 3 on the left, Brine 24 on the right.
features.orientation: 0° and 1× only; no reflection or rotation qualification
neighbour_rules: Test each pool independently before proximity; maintain watertight margins under native ticks
Never assume joined pressure, optical reflection, or stable interface
Use dry-mirrors in composite until t=0/60/600 physics receipts
features.simulation_notes: Water 3 uses FreeMass; Brine 24 uses CellularYield. Native containment, leaks, exchange, interface stability and capacity are untested; there is no real reflecting shader guarantee.

features.title: Silt Veil Spillway / collapsing hourglass terraces
features.role: A fractured levee deposits staggered Sand, Salt and Dust bands in the open lower basin.
features.orientation: 0° and 1× only; no reflection or rotation qualification
neighbour_rules: Keep free of active pool before standalone granular settling qualification
Dry replacements only in published combined gallery
Measure mobility and cell counts before considering reusable animated debris
features.simulation_notes: Sand 2, Salt 23, Dust 14 all mobile powder; these stamps are a t=0 composition and may slump, exchange or dissipate. Dry variant necessary for safe gallery.

combined_scene.title: The Last Causeway — fractured lunar datum and abandoned marsh procession

patterns.rule: tall gate → low stepping walk → elevated focal shrine; preserve one visual void
use copper stalks as rhythm around an isolated mineral cairn; do not imply biological growth
use inert dry-mirrors and set-sediments only in composite; test liquid/powder variants independently

combined_scene.status: dry design-only authored source-colour scene; fictive wetness and reflections
